---
title: "Landscapes Notebook"
output: html_document
---
        
```{r,message=FALSE}
library(igraph)
source("lib_landscape.R")
source("lib_hclust.R")
```



# Generate a random dataset
```{r}
set.seed(123)
e <- random_SE()
mcols(e)$is_variable <- sample(c(TRUE,FALSE),replace=TRUE,size=nrow(e))

# show position of the cells onto the landscape
ggplot(as.data.frame(colData(e))) +
        geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y)) +
        coord_equal() + 
        theme_classic()
```


# Build landscapes

make a knn grid
```{r}
g <- knn_array(e$x,e$y,k=100L)
```


Compute all landscapes, i.e. average expression of each gene according to the knn-grid
```{r}
mcols(e)$landscape <- knn_rowMeans(assay(e),g)
```


Plot first 10 landscapes
```{r}
gg_landscape(mcols(e[1:10])$landscape,attr(g,"x"),attr(g,"y"))
```



# Dimensionality reduction
```{r}
# Compute PCA of the landscapes
mcols(e)$landscape_pca <- local({
        M <- as.array(mcols(e)$landscape)
        dim(M) <- c(dim(M)[1],prod(dim(M)[-1]))
        irlba::prcomp_irlba(t(M),n=8,scale. = FALSE)$rotation
})

# Compute UMAP of the landscapes
mcols(e)$landscape_umap <- umap::umap(mcols(e)$landscape_pca,n_neighbors=31L,n_components=2L,min_dist=0.1)$layout
```


# Cluster landscapes
```{r}
# build nearest neighbor graph
G <- FNN::knn.index(mcols(e)$landscape_umap,11L)
G <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(cbind(as.vector(row(G)),as.vector(G)),directed = FALSE)

# Perform hierarchical clustering of the graph nodes, and cut at 15 groups
h <- as.hclust(igraph::cluster_walktrap(G))
H <- hclust_cut(h,k=15L)
mcols(e)$landscape_cluster <- factor(H$leafs$cluster)

# Display Full Tree
ggplot() + 
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=y,xend=x,yend=parent_y),data=H$nodes) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=parent_y,xend=parent_x,yend=parent_y),data=H$nodes) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=y,xend=x,yend=parent_y),data=H$leafs) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=parent_y,xend=parent_x,yend=parent_y),data=H$leafs) +
  #geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y,color=factor(cluster)),data=H$nodes) +
  geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y,color=factor(cluster)),data=H$leafs)

# Subset on uniform top branches
H$nodes <- H$nodes[H$nodes$type %in% c("mix","unif_root"),]
H$leafs <- H$leafs[H$leafs$type %in% "mix_child",]
H$nodes$y[!H$nodes$type%in%"mix"] <- min(H$nodes$y[H$nodes$type %in% "mix"]) - 3 # Hang layout


# Display Tree Subset 
p0 <- ggplot() + 
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=y,xend=x,yend=parent_y),data=H$nodes) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=parent_y,xend=parent_x,yend=parent_y),data=H$nodes) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=y,xend=x,yend=parent_y),data=H$leafs) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=parent_y,xend=parent_x,yend=parent_y),data=H$leafs) +
  geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y,color=factor(cluster)),data=H$leafs) +
  theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")

p0 + geom_label(aes(x=x,y=y,label=sprintf("%s:%s\nn=%d",id,cluster,num_leaf),fill=factor(cluster)),data=H$nodes)

# Compute average landscape for each cluster
M <- as.array(mcols(e)$landscape)
dim(M) <- c(dim(M)[1],prod(dim(M)[-1]))
M <- t(scale(t(M),scale=FALSE,center=TRUE))
M <- rowmean(M,mcols(e)$landscape_cluster)

# Extrapolate the cluster landscapes to higher nodes of the hierarchy
M <- (H$nodes$clusters / rowSums(H$nodes$clusters)) %*% M
dim(M) <- c(nrow(M),dim(mcols(e)$landscape)[-1])
H$nodes$landscapes <- M

# Display the landscape images on the tree layout
p <- local({
  p <- p0
  for(i in 1:nrow(H$nodes)) {
    gi <- ggplotGrob(gg_landscape_image(H$nodes$landscape[i,,]))
    p <- p + annotation_custom(gi,H$nodes$x[i]-200,H$nodes$x[i]+200,H$nodes$y[i]-5,H$nodes$y[i]+5)
  }
  p
})
p
```



# Display the landscape UMAP
```{r}
local({
  centers <- with(mcols(e),data.frame(
    cluster_name = levels(landscape_cluster),
    landscape_umap.1 = tapply(landscape_umap[,1],landscape_cluster,mean),
    landscape_umap.2 = tapply(landscape_umap[,2],landscape_cluster,mean)
  ))
  # Compute average landscape for each cluster
  M <- as.array(mcols(e)$landscape)
  dim(M) <- c(dim(M)[1],prod(dim(M)[-1]))
  M <- t(scale(t(M),scale=FALSE,center=TRUE))
  M <- rowmean(M,mcols(e)$landscape_cluster)
  dim(M) <- c(nrow(M),dim(mcols(e)$landscape)[-1])
  
  p <- ggplot(as(mcols(e),"data.frame"),aes(x=landscape_umap.1,y=landscape_umap.2)) + 
          geom_point(aes(color=landscape_cluster)) +
          geom_density_2d(aes(group=landscape_cluster),color="black",breaks=0.1) +
          coord_equal() +
          theme_void() + theme(legend.position="none")
  for(i in 1:nrow(M)) {
    gi <- ggplotGrob(gg_landscape_image(M[i,,]))
    p <- p + annotation_custom(gi,
      centers$landscape_umap.1[i]-0.3,centers$landscape_umap.1[i]+0.3,
      centers$landscape_umap.2[i]-0.3,centers$landscape_umap.2[i]+0.3)
  }
  p <- p + geom_text(aes(label=cluster_name),data=centers,size=3)
  p  
})
```


# Average cluster profile
```{r}
local({
        M <- as.array(mcols(e)$landscape)
        dim(M) <- c(dim(M)[1],prod(dim(M)[-1]))
        M <- t(scale(t(M),scale=FALSE,center=TRUE))
        M <- rowmean(M,mcols(e)$landscape_cluster)
        dim(M) <- c(nrow(M),dim(mcols(e)$landscape)[-1])
        gg_landscape(M)
})
```



# Generate a PDF of all landscapes in landscapes_32x32/ folder
```{r eval=FALSE}
local({
  for(i in seq(nrow(e))) {
    gg_landscape(mcols(e)$landscape[i,,,drop=FALSE],attr(g,"x"),attr(g,"y"))
    ggsave(file.path("landscapes_32x32",paste0("gene",i,".pdf")),width = 3,height=3)
  }
})
```
